Keval (bench): quick ask — need a focused microbench comparing streaming vs sync for function-call heavy prompts that return structured JSON. want p50/p95 token latency, token throughput, and CPU/GPU profiles. target: staging-gpu pool. can someone run this today?
Sara (runtime): sure. what seq len / batch sizes?
Keval (bench): seq=512, batch=1 and batch=8. iterations=300. model: open-instruct-13b-q4 (or closest we have on staging). include both tool/function-call enabled and a control without func_call.
Cheng Li: I can run the job on staging in ~20m. paste your run command so I don't guess flags.
Keval (bench): thanks. use this wrapper so it records pprof and raw latencies:
```bash
bench/run_stream_vs_sync.sh \
  --model open-instruct-13b-q4 \
  --seq-len 512 \
  --iters 300 \
  --batches "1,8" \
  --enable-funcall true \
  --trace-port 6060 \
  --save /tmp/microbench-$(date +%s).json
```
Cheng Li: ok running on staging-gpu-2. will expose pprof on :6060 and upload flamegraph. tagging @Linah for infra quota if it needs bump.
deploy-bot: scheduled job started (job id: jb-20260317-0045) :rocket:
Linah P.: I see the job, quota ok for now. ping if it needs a larger slice.
(25m later)
Cheng Li: quick summary from first pass (func_call on):
- batch=1: streaming p50=58ms / p95=235ms, sync p50=50ms / p95=198ms
- batch=8: streaming p50=120ms / p95=420ms, sync p50=105ms / p95=360ms
- tokens/sec (batch=1): streaming 320 tps, sync 360 tps
- tokens/sec (batch=8): streaming 2100 tps, sync 2350 tps
Cheng Li: CPU on the host spikes ~65% during streaming tails, GPU util ~75% both cases.
Sara (runtime): interesting — streaming has slightly worse p95 and lower throughput. could be serialization/chunking overhead when func_call returns structured json. did you check message encoding path?
Cheng Li: i instrumented the io path. biggest diff is serialization and chunk framing in the streaming code. attaching trace and flamegraph: https://internal-artifacts/redwood/bench/jb-20260317-0045/flamegraph.svg
Keval (bench): nice. can you also rerun with the streaming chunk size set to 1kb and 8kb (we suspect small chunks amplify overhead)? add flag `--stream-chunk-size`
Cheng Li: yes re-running with 1kb/8kb now. ETA ~12m.
(12m later)
Cheng Li: results with chunk-size changes (batch=1, func_call):
- chunk=1kb: streaming p95=260ms
- chunk=8kb: streaming p95=205ms
Notes: larger chunk reduces framing overhead but increases tail when the model generates many small tokens.
Sara (runtime): that confirms it. tradeoff between latency and immediacy. for function-call structured outputs we should consider coalescing small chunks or post-serialize before streaming when structure is small.
Linah P.: filing infra ticket for a short-lived higher-bandwidth runner for larger batched tests.
Keval (bench): action items: (1) Cheng to drop raw traces + flamegraph into the bench artifact (done link above), (2) Cheng to push a small PR that adds `--stream-chunk-size` knob to the bench harness, (3) Sara to draft a runtime optimization note (coalesce small frames / buffer threshold) and propose a default. anyone else? :eyes:
Sara (runtime): I'll write the note and include perf numbers.
Cheng Li: PR up in a few hours, will attach job id in the PR.
Keval (bench): great — thanks team :thumbsup:
